FULL TEXT:
Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha
Rourkela
No. BPUT/22357, Date 29.07.2017
WALK-IN-INTERVIEW FOR ENGAGEMENT OF RETIRED PERSONS
The Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha established by an Act of Odisha Legislative
Assembly and having 153 Constituent/ affiliated colleges is now looking for Retired Senior
person having good exposure in the areas as given below.
The minimum qualification shall be graduate in respective discipline to suit the requirement of
work. Knowledge and /or work experience of computer shall be added advantage. Experience in
respective field in Government/ Government educational institution shall be preferred. The
posting shall be at Rourkela. The person should be below the age of 65 years as on date of
application and physically fit. The retired person against whom departmental proceeding or
criminal case are contemplated / pending or who have been penalized for misconduct during the
period of preceding five years will not be eligible for consideration. The engagement shall initially
for a period of one year and may subsequently be extended based on performance.
Sl Name of the position Number Consolidated
remuneration P.M*
1 Sr. person (Establishment Section) 01 Rs. 20,000/-
2 -do- (Examination Section) 01 Rs. 20,000/
3 -do- (Finance Section) 01 Rs. 20,000/
4 -do- (Construction activities) 01 Rs. 20,000/
* Note : The pay shall be last pay drawn – (minus) pension or Rs. 20000/- whichever is higher
limiting to maximum of Rs.20,000/- per month.
Interested candidate are required to attend the interview at BPUT, Chhend, Rourkela, 09.08.2017
with application in plane paper addressed to the Registrar, BPUT, resume with two recent
passport size color photographs and other testimonials as proof of their qualification, experience,
last pay certificate, PPO etc. One set of photocopies of the original certificate and other relevant
documents are required to be deposited at the time of interview. The candidates are also required
to bring all the original certificates/documents for verification on the spot.
No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview. The engagement is purely on temporary
basis and will form no basis either legally or otherwise to claim right for the regularization against
the post or any other post. The authority reserves the right to reject any or all the applications or
cancel the entire process of interview without assigning any reasons thereof. The authority also
reserves the right to terminate any such engagement on contract at any time without assigning
any reasons by giving one month notice.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR
